name: f64_precision
source: Open Nunction Main() { Float X = 16777217.0; Print(X); }

name: mixed_reassignment
source: Open Nunction Main() { Int N = 3; Float X = -1.25; X = N + X; Print(X); X = X / 2.0; Print(X); }

name: float_comparisons
source: Open Nunction Main() { Float X = 1.5; If (X < 2.0) { Print(1); } If (X == 1.5) { Print(2); } If (X != 2.0) { Print(3); } If (X >= 1.5) { Print(4); } If (X > 1.0) { Print(5); } If (X <= 1.5) { Print(6); } }

name: float_increment_decrement
source: Open Nunction Main() { Float X = 0.5; For (Int I = 0; I < 3; X++) { Print(X); I = I + 1; } For (Int J = 0; J < 2; X--) { Print(X); J = J + 1; } Print(X); }

name: float_parameter_return
source: Float Twice(Float X) { Return X * 2.0; } Open Nunction Main() { Print(Twice(1.25)); }

name: mixed_abi_nested_calls
source: Float Add(Int N, Float X, Weld Label) { Print(Label); Return N + X; } Float Identity(Float X) { Return X; } Open Nunction Main() { Print(Add(3, Identity(1.25), "mixed")); }

name: float_values_across_calls
source: Float Identity(Float X) { Return X; } Open Nunction Main() { Print(Identity(1.0) + (Identity(2.0) + (Identity(3.0) + (Identity(4.0) + (Identity(5.0) + (Identity(6.0) + Identity(7.0))))))); }

name: float_power_negation
source: Open Nunction Main() { Float X = 2.0; Print(-(X ** 3.0)); }
